issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְעָדִית עֶדִי' means 'and adorned yourself with jewelry/ornaments' (the verb עָדָה with the noun עֶדִי as its object). The Chinese renders 'עֶדִי' as a place name '亞低' (a transliteration), which is a mistranslation — it is not a place name but the noun 'ornament/jewelry'.
